content:
incident-bot: Pager: high_latency_99p triggered for hosted-api-us-east-1 (alert_id: ALRT-8721). Current 99th pct latency = 4.8s (> SLO 2.0s). Paging primary: @aisha.

aisha: saw it, joining bridge now. grabbing context from metrics and runbook.

aisha: @riley can you confirm whether this is a single-model hotspot or global routing issue? I see CPU on pool-gpu-3 spiking.
riley: looking — KV cache miss rate is up ~45% in the last 3m, also batch size jumped for some long-seq requests. suspicious traffic pattern from a handful of API keys.

aisha: ok, marking preliminary impact: degraded tail latency for hosted generation endpoints in us-east-1. potential customer impact: high-traffic customers may see 5-10s tail delays.

aisha: @tom_h i'm going to hand off primary to you in 10m for the overnight window unless you want to take it now. i'm on a quick call at 20:10.
tom_h: I can take primary now. switching my oncall status to primary in rotation. leaving @aisha as secondary for context handoff.

aisha: documented handoff notes: recent deploy rolled out scale-policy change to dedicated pools at 18:03 — might be related. runbook pointers: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-99p and the quick mitigation section below.

aisha: quick mitigation (from runbook):
```
# temporarily lower batch_target to reduce long queueing
redwoodctl pool update --pool gpu-pool-us-east-1 --config '{"batch_target":4, "max_batch_latency_ms":50}'
# if traffic spike is abusive, add short IP block rule
redwoodctl network deny --ip 203.0.113.42 --reason "suspected abusive seq flood"
```

tom_h: applying reduced batch_target now on pool-gpu-3. patch applied, watching.

incident-bot: Note: config change event recorded (cfg-change-3092) by tom_h at 1819993452.

riley: after batch change, 99p dropped to 2.3s within 90s, KV miss still elevated but falling. Good improvement.

priya: flagged two customer sessions (acct: acme-enterprises, acct: betaapps) with repeated retries. opening a support ticket and marking P1 if errors persist.

jorge: we should also consider a temp alert threshold bump to avoid pager noise while we stabilize — propose setting SLO alert from 2.0s -> 4.0s for 15m with an annotation. thoughts?

tom_h: agree as long as we annotate and automate revert. I'll set a suppression window: 15m with a comment.

tom_h: running suppression:
```
# suppress high_latency_99p alert for 15m with audit note
redwoodctl alerts suppress --id ALRT-8721 --duration 15m --note "temporary suppression while mitigating KV miss / batching" --actor tom_h
```

incident-bot: Alert ALRT-8721 suppressed by tom_h until 1819995387 (15m). Audit id: SUP-4219.

aisha: logging action items: 1) monitor KV miss root cause (riley), 2) follow up with model infra team about the scale-policy rollback candidate (aisha), 3) customer outreach for the two flagged accounts (priya), 4) postmortem draft if incident persists beyond 1h (tom_h).

riley: quick note — I'm seeing a spike from a small set of 10 API keys tied to one client integration. will DM security for potential injection/abuse pattern.

priya: support ticket created: TCK-9982 (ACME) and TCK-9983 (BETA). I added the mitigation steps and ETA for next update in 20m.

ops-pager: handoff reminder — night shift overlap between 23:50-00:20 is reduced this week (coverage gap). Tom, if this continues to worsen around midnight we need to escalate to on-call lead.

tom_h: noted re: coverage gap. if anything degrades after suppression ends I'll escalate immediately. For now, moving to watch mode and leaving suppression in place.

aisha: leaving a short checklist in the handoff thread for the follow-on:
- confirm suppression revert at 1819995387
- check model infra rollback flag state
- make sure customer tickets have clear impact text
- if KV miss > 30% for another 15m -> declare incident and start bridge

aisha: handing primary to tom_h now. I'm available as secondary until 1820002000.
tom_h: got it. taking primary. final note: if we need to widen suppression window, runbook requires a senior oncall sign-off (>30m). pinging @jorge for sign-off if needed. :thumbsup:

jorge: ack, will review if you ask for extension.

incident-bot: Thread closed for routing: handoff complete. Next status update scheduled at 1819994200 or on any state change.
